Hatsume's Babies.name: Hatsume's Babies
Hatsume's Babies.questStatement: Mei Hatsume of Class 1-H has decided you are perfect test data. She has a bench full of babies, hover soles, a grapple launcher and power-assist arm braces among them, and she needs someone to wear them, move in them and report exactly how they fail. Power Loader has approved the tests on one condition: somebody sensible must be present. She is not sure where that person is.
Hatsume's Babies.mainObjective: Field-test Mei Hatsume's prototypes and help her fix what breaks.

completionCondition.query: The PC has tested several of Mei Hatsume's prototypes under Power Loader's approval and helped her produce at least one working revision.

Hatsume's Babies.questDesignBrief: Slapstick with consequences. Mei talks nonstop, measures the PC mid-sentence and celebrates every crater as data. Each baby has its own power supply and failure point; tests run in the Development Studio or an approved yard, and Power Loader shouts her surname the moment smoke appears. Soot, bruises and small explosions are fine; serious injury never happens because Power Loader cuts the power first. The PC wins her respect by solving a real engineering problem, never by praising her. A seed for later: she already treats the Sports Festival as a showroom. Recovery Girl treats burns.
